description: Approve or deny a new client (a bot, or a single-instance AI such as Claude or ChatGPT) that EMET flagged on its first write. A new client is read-limited until approved. Only the owner, or the chief-of-staff bot named by EMET_COS_TAG, may decide. Pending clients are listed in emet_initialize and emet_status as client_approvals.

as.description: Required when the client_id already has approved tags: add keeps them all (several bots on one shared client); rename retires one

from.description: With as=rename on a client that has several approved tags: the tag being replaced

reason.description: Optional note kept with the decision

tag.description: The pending client's tag, as listed in client_approvals.pending

name: emet_client_approve
